question: The exchange rate system was reformed to reflect market conditions. What type of exchange rate regime did India adopt post-1991?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Managed Floating Exchange Rate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India adopted the **Managed Floating Exchange Rate** regime post-1991 as part of its economic liberalization policies.
 
• A managed floating exchange rate allows the exchange rate to be primarily determined by market forces but permits intervention by the central bank to stabilize or influence rates.
 
• The 1991 economic reforms were triggered
